trimComparisons.model: Toyota RAV4 LE vs Honda CR-V EX‑L
trimComparisons.comparison: The RAV4 LE is more basic (cloth seats, standard safety suite, no power liftgate), but is significantly less expensive (≈$26.5 k fee-inclusive) and under 40 k miles. The CR‑V EX‑L adds leather, power liftgate, moonroof, heated seats, remote start, blind‑spot monitoring, adaptive cruise—more comfort and convenience at a premium (~$28.7 k).
